name: We Met v8.8.0 No Payment Gateway
changes: Removes every online checkout SDK, popup, order endpoint, verification endpoint and payment webhook
Removes customer purchase buttons, recurring-access purchase controls and payment-specific public pages
Removes unused manual-transfer, QR and app-store purchase modules and dependencies
Keeps customer talk-time balances, redeem codes, calls, profiles, support and existing private-access records
Keeps screenshot deterrence on every shipped customer page with app-switch obscuring, print blocking and capture restrictions
Locks the browser policy to self-hosted scripts with no third-party payment frames
Bumps all portal service-worker and asset cache versions to 8.8.0
